messages:
elaine: heads-up: onboarding sample app shows sharp 429 spikes during mass imports. looks like aggressive prefetch(4) + SDK retry behavior causing duplicate inflight page requests. anyone free to brainstorm quick mitigations? :sweat_smile:

noah: is the duplicate traffic from token refresh retry races or identical cursor requests?

elaine: both. token refresh sometimes runs concurrently in JS SDK and the app kicks off identical cursor fetches. trace: fetch cursor=abc -> 401 -> refresh triggered; meanwhile another fetch for cursor=abc also triggers refresh -> two retries for same cursor.

priya: parity gap: Go SDK uses singleflight for token refresh and has a small in-memory request coalescer. JS SDK currently lacks both. short-term: reduce prefetch to 1-2, add client-side dedupe cache keyed by session+cursor (ttl 3s), and respect Retry-After on 429s.

elaine: i can ship app change behind feature flag: prefetch=1 + dedupe cache. any code suggestions for dedupe?

noah: implement a tiny map of Promise goobers: `if (inflight[cursor]) return inflight[cursor]; inflight[cursor] = fetchPage(...).finally(() => delete inflight[cursor])` That prevents duplicate requests while a page is inflight.

priya: also add single-flight token refresh to JS SDK: export `auth.refreshOnce()` that coalesces refresh callers per user id. keep old API but deprecate naive manual refresh patterns in samples.

elaine: good. i'll add backoff + jitter too and cap retries to 3. we'll enable 10% canary in staging.

ci-bot: Deploy queued: sampleapp/onboard-dedupe-smallprefetch -> staging (job #9987).

noah: once deployed, QA should run 50 simulated users hitting import to verify `dx.client.duplicate_requests` metric drops. if it's only a 20% drop, we push SDK single-flight quick patch next.

priya: agreed. for the SDK patch i'll mirror Go's singleflight semantics and add unit tests for concurrent refresh calls and request coalescing. i'll also add an opt-in `client.coalesce=true` flag to the client config so teams can enable without app changes.

elaine: perfect. i'll attach logs from the staging run here after deploy. thanks!
